pumac-2020-power-05.prompt: **Problem 2.1.** **Ant-paths.** Let $P$ be a (convex) polyhedron with surface $S(P)$. pumac-2020-power-05.answer: Cut the surface at the vertex and flatten (the angle sum at a vertex is less than $2\pi$); the straight segment between two points on either side of the vertex is shorter.
